name: dynamic-factory
description: Visual software/product factory with pluggable LLM providers

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:web" "cd services/api && uv run python -m dynamic_factory.main"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && cd services/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy src
